name: CG Animated Feature: Location Establishing Clip
description: Video preset for a location clip in the CG Animated Feature look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second establishing shot. State the camera move, time of day, and two things moving in the scene. Keep the architecture consistent with the entity.
context_prompt: short establishing clip of the location with one slow camera move and ambient life in the frame, stylized 3D animated feature film still, appealing simplified proportions, large expressive eyes, sculpted hair shapes, soft subsurface skin, tactile cloth and fur, cinematic three-point lighting, warm key and cool fill, soft global illumination, shallow depth of field, smooth feature-quality character animation, readable poses, subtle facial acting, slow cinematic camera moves with depth of field
negative_prompt: photorealistic human, uncanny, flat 2d, low-poly, harsh shadows, extra fingers, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
